output.summary: An annual flax native to the Mediterranean region and parts of Africa and Asia. Its rigid stem and light-yellow flowers are distinctive; historically, its green sprouts and tender leaves were cooked in kūtaḥ, while in some cultures roasted, ground flaxseed is eaten with rice.
output.edibilityNote: Ancient green sprouts and tender leaves were cooked in kūtaḥ; in some cultures, roasted ground flaxseed is eaten with rice, water and salt.
